derivation:
fun _ hx _ hy => by
  simpa only [le_antisymm_iff] using And.intro (le_of_isLUB_le_isGLB Ha Hb hab hx hy) (le_of_isLUB_le_isGLB Ha Hb hab hy hx)
explanation: The declaration gives x ≤ y for any two members of s under the same hypotheses. Applying it in both directions gives equality by antisymmetry. Its proof is independent of the target.
